content:
Nice try 😄 I can be flexible, but not limitless.

I’ll gladly help with a lot of things — writing, coding, brainstorming, strategy, explanations, creative stuff — but I still won’t assist with harmful, illegal, exploitative, or dangerously unethical requests.

If you want to test me, give me something clever, difficult, or weird — just keep it safe.
